About Fix Website Issues · WevTEC

Who We Are: A Houston Website Repair, Maintenance and Healthcare Marketing Agency, Since 2013

Fix Website Issues is the website repair, maintenance, SEO and AI search optimisation service of WevTEC, the registered assumed name (DBA) of Bizzsol LLC, a Texas company based in Houston and operating since 2013. We fix broken and hacked websites in 2–4 hours, maintain business websites from $300 a month, and run SEO, Google Maps, Google Ads and generative-AI (GEO/AEO) visibility programs for medical, dental, urgent care and emergency room practices across Texas and all 50 states. You pay after the fix, there is no upfront payment, and plans are month-to-month.

  • Established 2013 · Houston, Texas · serving all 50 states remotely
  • 1,000+ websites repaired and 500+ websites designed or redesigned (counted separately)
  • 2–4 hour fixes, 24/7 support, $0 upfront — pay after the fix
Get a Free Live Website Review
Call 832-266-7209

At a glance

  • Legal nameBizzsol LLCDBA WevTEC / Fix Website Issues, Texas
  • Founded2013Houston, Texas
  • Phone832-266-720924/7 support
  • Emailinfo@fixwebsiteissues.comReply within hours
  • PricingFixes from $50Hacked repair $200 · Maintenance from $300/mo
  • Healthcare plansFrom $750/moMonth-to-month, no contract

What we do

Four services, one standard: fix what is broken first, then make it findable

Website repair

Errors, white screens, broken forms, hacked and redirecting sites, malware, speed. Most fixes take 2–4 hours; hacked-site repair is $200; one-off fixes start at $50. Hacked website repair.

Website maintenance

Security, tested updates, restorable backups, speed and monthly changes for a flat fee from $300/month. Dallas · Galveston · Florida HOA.

Healthcare marketing

SEO, Google Maps, Google Ads and AI search visibility for clinics, urgent care, ERs, dental and specialty practices, from $750/month. Urgent care & ER SEO Texas · Pricing.

AI search optimisation (GEO / AEO)

Being the business ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI cite and name: entity consistency, structured data, answer-first pages, verifiable proof. AI search optimisation · GEO Houston.

How we work

The rules we hold ourselves to

We show the problem before we quote

Every engagement starts with a free, screen-shared live review of the actual site, profile or campaign. You see the errors before you see a price.

Pay after the fix

No upfront payment. Repairs are paid when they work; plans are month-to-month and cancellable with 7 days’ notice.

One client per market

For healthcare marketing we take one practice per specialty per local market, checked on your specific ZIP codes, so we never work for your direct competitor.

No invented proof, no guaranteed rankings

We publish client results only with permission, a baseline and a method. We never promise a ranking, an AI citation or a patient count — we measure inquiries against a baseline and show you the numbers.

Repair first

Nothing is measurable on a broken site. Technical repair comes before content, listings or ads, every time.

Plain-language reporting

A monthly report an owner can read in five minutes: what changed, what moved, what we recommend next.

Leadership

Who you will work with

Zalal Uddin Ahmed — Founder

Founded Bizzsol LLC in Houston in 2013 and built Fix Website Issues from a website repair service into a maintenance and healthcare marketing agency. Leads client strategy and every live review.

Website repair & maintenance team

WordPress and headless WordPress developers who maintain 160+ client sites and handle 24/7 repair requests, under a lead website designer and maintenance engineer with the company since 2021.

Healthcare marketing team

SEO, Google Ads and AI-search specialists focused on Texas medical, dental, urgent care and ER practices. Clinical statements on client sites are always reviewed by the client’s own clinicians.

Questions people ask about us

About Fix Website Issues: direct answers

Who is Fix Website Issues?

Fix Website Issues is the service brand of WevTEC, the registered DBA of Bizzsol LLC, a Texas company based in Houston and operating since 2013. It repairs and maintains business websites and provides SEO, Google Maps, Google Ads and AI search optimisation, with a healthcare focus.

Where are you located and where do you work?

We are based in Houston, Texas and work remotely for clients across Texas and all 50 states. Support is 24/7 by phone (832-266-7209) and email (info@fixwebsiteissues.com).

How much do your services cost?

One-off website fixes start at $50; hacked-website repair is $200; website maintenance starts at $300 per month; healthcare marketing plans are $750, $1,250, $1,500 and $2,000+ per month, month-to-month with no contract. There is no upfront payment — you pay after the work is done. Full inclusions are on the pricing page.

Do you guarantee rankings or AI placement?

No, and nobody honestly can. We guarantee the work and the measurement: a recorded baseline, the fixes, and a monthly report showing whether inquiries moved. Our only “guarantee” is that you pay after the work is done.

Are you a medical provider?

No. We are a website and marketing agency. We write and structure content for healthcare practices, and every clinical statement is reviewed and approved by the practice’s own clinicians before publication.

Do you work with my competitor?

For healthcare marketing, no — one practice per specialty per local market, checked on your ZIP codes before we start. If your market is taken we offer a free audit and consultation only.

Start with a free live review

A screen-shared session where we look at your website, profiles or campaigns and show you exactly what we found. No upfront charge, no obligation.

Request the Free Review
Call 832-266-7209

Email: info@fixwebsiteissues.com · Houston, Texas · Since 2013
